unit.why: A single anecdote: the Magelnitsa rebbe fell gravely ill, people prayed and sent word to R. Moshe of Zelechow, and when someone asked why no great doctors were brought, R. Moshe answered with a teaching on the tsaddik of the upper and lower aspects.

stories.end_quote: כן שמעתי מנכדי הצדיק ר״מ הנ"ל
stories.summary_en: When the Magelnitsa rebbe was gravely ill and towns recited Psalms for him, R. Moshe of Zelechow, asked why no great doctors were brought as for another famous tsaddik, explained that the rebbe is a 'supernal tsaddik' whose illness and cure are above nature, so doctors are irrelevant.

quotes: והיו אומרים תהלים ומבקשים רחמים עבורו
tags.why: Psalms recited as intercession for the sick rebbe
petitionary prayer for the rebbe's recovery
